historicalEvidence.boundary: Historical calibration review and one retained whole-JAR digest do not prove formal H1 source-to-binary reproducibility or contract conformance.

confirmedCompatibleMechanics: basic unique-pair TP, FP, and FN arithmetic
scenario-scoped method identity and overload distinction within the legacy signature string
abstention count with unmatched expected pairs retained as FN
null Double results for zero denominators
directed edge proof lookup and missing-chain diagnostic
Java CLI coverage for the calibration contract

blockingGaps.observed: Legacy validation permits only SYNTHETIC or CALIBRATION and rejects HOLDOUT.
blockingGaps.required: A separately versioned formal-holdout manifest, ingress, validation, report, and CLI contract.

blockingGaps.observed: Legacy pair identity is scenarioId plus Method(sourceRevision,path,signature).
blockingGaps.required: Canonical UTF-8 JSON and SHA-256 identity using repositorySnapshotSha256, scenarioId, fullyQualifiedDeclaringType, methodName, ordered parameterTypes, and returnType; path excluded; constructor, array, overload, primitive, and generic-erasure rules enforced.

blockingGaps.observed: Legacy scorer collapses proposals into a HashSet and reports additional duplicates separately rather than counting every duplicate occurrence as FP.
blockingGaps.required: Every proposal occurrence classified exactly once as TP or FP; every gold pair classified exactly once as matched or FN; each duplicate occurrence after first credit is FP.

blockingGaps.observed: Claim/proof records do not encode or validate entity, action, assertion role, polarity, or business-condition disposition.
blockingGaps.required: Frozen proof disposition for entity, action, role, assertion polarity, condition, ambiguity, and evidence sufficiency before a canonical pair can receive TP credit; an exact method with any wrong disposition is FP and leaves the necessary gold pair FN.

blockingGaps.observed: Truth validation only checks declared chain members and edges; it does not require the chain to cover every necessary pair or exactly every adjacent ordered edge.
blockingGaps.required: Truth marks chain-required scenarios, binds an ordered array of canonical pair digests, derives exactly N-1 adjacent edges, rejects omitted, extra, reversed, and non-adjacent edges, and computes chain coverage after pair classification.

blockingGaps.observed: Scenario coverage counts scenarios with supported TPs; chain null has no machine-readable reason and malformed mandatory truth can become an unavailable metric.
blockingGaps.required: Scenario coverage counts any valid proposed pair, mandatory post-dispatch truth/schema failures are INVALID, and every unavailable denominator carries a reason code.

blockingGaps.observed: One legacy binding and score object cannot partition repositories or enforce per-repository thresholds.
blockingGaps.required: Per-repository counts and metrics, micro and equal-weight macro aggregate, Wilson intervals, strict unrounded precision greater than 0.80 and recall greater than 0.60 for every repository, and non-masking decision logic.

blockingGaps.observed: No independently implemented recomputation binary, SHA-256 receipt, or formal conformance-vector bundle exists.
blockingGaps.required: Two independently bound implementations agree byte-for-byte on raw classifications, counts, metrics, null reasons, coverage, confidence intervals, and decision for every vector.

blockingGaps.observed: Legacy Truth identifies scenarios only by strings plus expected pairs and optional chains; it does not bind each scenario to repository snapshot, test/source provenance, coverage stratum, or sealed truth disposition.
blockingGaps.required: Every sealed scenario has a unique canonical ID, repositorySnapshotSha256, exact test/source provenance digests, one frozen coverage stratum, and sealed truth disposition. Duplicate identity, wrong snapshot, missing provenance/stratum/disposition, malformed schema, or digest mismatch makes the dispatched execution INVALID.

requiredConformanceVectors: same canonical method with different source path remains the same pair
same scenario and signature in different repository snapshots remains distinct
overload parameter order, arrays, primitives, generic erasure, constructors, and return types
duplicate first valid claim plus one or more duplicate FPs
same canonical method with wrong entity, action, role, polarity, condition, ambiguity, or insufficient evidence becomes FP and leaves the necessary gold pair FN

scenario validity: duplicate canonical ID, wrong repository snapshot, missing test/source provenance, missing coverage stratum, missing truth disposition, malformed schema, and digest mismatch are INVALID
empty proposal with nonempty gold and zero proposal denominator
valid proposed FP still contributes scenario coverage
unsupported and UNRESOLVED abstentions retain necessary FNs
complete ordered chain and omitted, extra, reversed, and non-adjacent edges
per-repository threshold pass, strict-boundary failure, unavailable metric, and aggregate non-masking
Wilson interval reference values and independent byte-identical recomputation

recommendedImplementationBoundary.reason: Changing SFBL005-METHOD-PAIR-001 in place would reinterpret immutable calibration evidence and risk breaking BOXING/RealWorld replay compatibility.
minimumDeliverables: reference conformance vectors and expected canonical bytes/digests
